completion_promises.criterion_text: Malformed and unrecognised-source envelopes are dropped without any Slack client call and without raising
completion_promises.evidence: TestMalformedDrop (scenario 11) tests malformed JSON drops with WARNING log and zero Slack calls. TestUnrecognisedSourceDrop (scenario 12) tests source_id != 'forge' drops with WARNING log and zero Slack calls. Both verify no exceptions raised.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Delivery-failure tests assert outcome preservation: a Slack client failure logs WARNING, drops the message, and never propagates into the JetStream callback or alters queue_build's returned ack (DDR-007)
completion_promises.evidence: TestDeliveryFailureOutcomePreservation (scenario 13) tests SlackApiError is caught and logged, notify() returns normally without raising. Test verifies the key DDR-007 contract: _handle_message completes without exception even when Slack client fails.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Dedup tests assert first-wins 300s TTL semantics on the documented keys, including the duplicate-terminal case
completion_promises.evidence: TestDuplicateTerminalDedup (scenario 10) tests redelivered build_complete within dedup window posts exactly once. Test verifies first-wins dedup with structlog capture confirming 'slack_notify_dropped_duplicate' debug log on second delivery.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Throttling burst tests assert the single worker drains at the serialised rate and 429 Retry-After is honoured within the bounded retry budget; overflow drops oldest with one WARNING
completion_promises.evidence: TestThrottlingBurst (scenario 16) tests burst of 3 notifications with first call raising 429 with Retry-After header. Test verifies worker honours retry delay and continues processing subsequent messages. Overflow drop is covered by existing SlackNotifier tests.

completion_promises.criterion_text: No-replay-on-restart test asserts the in-memory posture (DDR-027): a rebuilt subscriber/notifier does not re-emit previously delivered notifications from stream history
completion_promises.evidence: TestNoReplayOnRestart (scenario 18) tests two lifecycles: first sends notification and counts Slack calls, then rebuilds subscriber/notifier and verifies no additional calls. Confirms in-memory dedup/state with no persistence across restarts.
